blurb: The palace of the Ottoman sultans for almost 400 years, on the point between two seas.

facts.t: Sultan Mehmed II began the palace in 1459, six years after he took Constantinople. It was the centre of the Ottoman Empire until the 1850s, and became a museum in 1924, soon after the republic was founded.

The Privy Chamber keeps objects that, by Muslim tradition, belonged to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, including a mantle and hairs of his beard. Qur'an is recited beside them through the day.
